expenses.newSubtitle: Attach the invoice and fill in the details. Press "Read automatically" to fill them from the invoice, or type them yourself.
expenses.noCompanies: No companies are set up yet. Ask the Procurement Manager to add companies first.
expenses.filesHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 5 files, 10 MB each. "Read automatically" reads the first file; originals are kept permanently.
expenses.reading: Uploading and reading the invoice, this can take up to a minute…
expenses.listSubtitle: Your invoices and their review status.
expenses.empty: You have not uploaded any invoices yet.
expenses.replaceHint: Upload a new file if the invoice needs to be replaced. The earlier version is kept.
expenses.rejectedNote: The amount stays unresolved with you until you correct and resubmit it.
expenses.ocrDone: We read the invoice (and its ZATCA QR code when visible). Please check every field against the file before submitting.
expenses.ocrSkipped: Automatic reading is not switched on yet. Please type the invoice details from the file.
expenses.ocrFailed: We could not read this invoice automatically. Please type the details from the file.
expenses.earlierVersions: {count, plural, one {# earlier version} other {# earlier versions}}

errors.unauthorized: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.notEditable: This expense can no longer be edited.
errors.badProject: This project / location / department does not belong to the chosen company.
errors.tooManyFiles: You can upload up to 5 files.
errors.fileType: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP files are allowed.
errors.fileTooLarge: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.storage: File storage is not available right now. Please contact the administrator.
errors.requiredFields: Vendor, invoice date and total are required to submit.
errors.badAmount: Enter amounts as numbers with up to two decimals.
errors.badVat: The VAT number must be exactly 15 digits.
errors.inconsistent: Subtotal plus VAT does not equal the total. Please check the amounts.
errors.notDeletable: Only drafts that were never submitted can be deleted.
errors.typeRequired: Choose the invoice type to submit.
